name: What are the signs that my old siding needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my old siding needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate your siding needs replacement include visible damage like cracks, warping, or rotting. Fading color, peeling paint, or mold/mildew growth that won't clean off are also indicators. Increased energy bills can signal deteriorating insulation properties of your old siding. Additionally, if you notice loose panels or a need for frequent repairs, it might be more cost-effective to replace the siding entirely rather than continuing with repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include cracks, warping, rot, fading, peeling paint, mold, increased energy bills, or loose panels.
